name: fools-errand
description: A Fool's Errand - The Dark Tower Ascent. A 1-bit retro climber inspired by Browning's Childe Roland.

scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.json sw.js www/ && cp -R css js www/
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
